main_text.l: Cognitis differentijs ad unam zodiaci partem
sunt habi tudines. Quare sicut crescunt ab initio
Arietis ad principium Cancri, ita ab hoc minuuntur in finem
uariantur, ideo quod angulus inclinationis æqua-
toris ad Horizontem illico mutatur, ipse uero Ho-
rizon tanto fit obliquior et decliuior,
quanto alter polorum assurgit altius. Itaq; ad singulos gradus
nalium tabulæ supputandæ sunt, quibus expeditis
facillime confici possunt, differentijs in hemicyclio
septentrionali zodiaci, ut dictum est, deductis ab ascensionibus
zodiaci à quatuor punctis Cardinalibus inchoati simul

page.notes: Gothic/italic mixed text rendered as printed; the Greek headings "ποριςμα" are as printed (likely πόρισμα). Some words in the scan are blurred, notably "mutato", "ascensiones", "uariantur" and "Horizon"; read as printed. The last line "O 4 emer" appears to be a catchword-like fragment at the foot of the text and is kept in the body; it may be a signature or catchword (possibly "emerso").
